description.value: Golden Bakery & Deli is a family-owned institution in Golden, BC, founded in 1970 by Joe and Evelyn Dusevic and still operated by the Dusevic family over 55 years later. The bakery produces a broad range of house-made breads — sourdough, multigrain, rye, and gluten-free — alongside baked goods with vegan and GF options and specialty coffee using Kicking Horse beans. For a touring cyclist rolling through the Columbia Valley, it offers a genuine local stop for fresh carbs and a quality coffee.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for goldenbakery.ca loaded successfully and confirms this is an active, family-owned bakery and deli in Golden, BC, operating since 1970. The site details fresh-baked breads, coffee, and baked goods with GF/vegan options, and a rewards/online ordering program — no mention of bike infrastructure, water refill, washrooms, or most amenity categories. The OSM record's closing time (17:30) disagrees with the website (5pm/17:00 Mon–Sat), and OSM omits the Sunday hours shown on the website.
concerns: OSM closing time (17:30 Mon–Sat) does not match the website (5:00 pm / 17:00 Mon–Sat) — minor discrepancy.
OSM has no Sunday hours; website shows Sunday hours (7am–4pm) — OSM record appears incomplete.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A long-established, actively operating bakery and deli in a cycling hub (Golden, BC) with fresh bread, baked goods, and quality coffee — a clear benefit to touring cyclists passing through the Columbia Valley.

provenance.category_correction_reason: A bakery/deli is not a grocery store, but it does supply packaged and fresh food relevant to touring cyclists and is a reasonable fit for the Groceries category in the absence of a dedicated Bakery/Café category.
